Quote tiles rotate per step (agent bulletin board, on-call staff said stop not required, message board not apparent to leaders), each sitting away from the diagram on the right.

rationale: The title's point (signals treated as routine) is not shown by the diagram, which depicts agents converging on a mirror; it surfaces only by reading timeline item 3 and the quote tiles.
